```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, eval = isTRUE(params$execute), message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(qs)
library(here)
library(patchwork)
source(here("R", "plotting.R"))

combined_final <- qread(here("data", "derived", "visium_scored.qs"))
epithelial <- qread(here("data", "derived", "epithelial_diffusion_map.qs"))
figure_dir <- here("results", "figures", "supplementary")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# All sections and pathology annotations

```{r all-sections}
sample_order <- read_csv(here("config", "sample_manifest.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(include) |>
  pull(sample_id)

s1_clusters <- plot_spatial_samples(
  combined_final,
  group_by = "combined_cluster",
  samples = sample_order,
  colors = cluster_colors,
  ncol = 5,
  point_size = 1.3
)
s1_pathology <- plot_spatial_samples(
  combined_final,
  group_by = "Adenoma",
  samples = sample_order,
  colors = region_colors,
  ncol = 5,
  point_size = 1.3
)
save_plot(s1_clusters, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_all_sections_clusters.pdf"), 16, 14)
save_plot(s1_pathology, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_all_sections_pathology.pdf"), 16, 14)
```

# Quality control and modality contributions

```{r qc}
qc <- combined_final@meta.data |>
  select(Sample_ID, nCount_Spatial, nFeature_Spatial, percent.mt, ADT_n_detected, ADT_isotype_fraction) |>
  pivot_longer(-Sample_ID, names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")
s2 <- ggplot(qc, aes(Sample_ID, value)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))
save_plot(s2, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_QC.pdf"), 12, 9)
```

# Additional score, pseudotime, and deconvolution views

```{r score-features}
s3 <- FeaturePlot(
  combined_final,
  reduction = "wnn.umap",
  features = c("SenMayo", "IEX", "Stem_Signature", "Senepy", "CytoTRACE2_Score", "dpt_pseudotime"),
  ncol = 3,
  keep.scale = "feature"
) & theme_void()
save_plot(s3, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_scores_umap.pdf"), 11, 7)
```

```{r pseudotime-spatial}
s4 <- SpatialFeaturePlot(
  combined_final,
  features = "dpt_pseudotime",
  images = sample_order,
  ncol = 5,
  keep.scale = "all"
)
save_plot(s4, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_pseudotime_all_sections.pdf"), 16, 14)
```

```{r cell2location}
cell_types <- intersect(
  c("Dysplastic_Stem_like", "Dysplastic_Senescent_like", "Dysplastic_Proliferating", "CD8.T", "Fibroblast"),
  colnames(combined_final@meta.data)
)
s5 <- FeaturePlot(combined_final, reduction = "wnn.umap", features = cell_types, ncol = 3) & theme_void()
save_plot(s5, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_cell2location.pdf"), 11, 7)
```

# Luminal-surface distance

```{r surface-distance}
stem_distance <- read_csv(here("results", "tables", "surface_distance_stemness.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
senescence_distance <- read_csv(here("results", "tables", "surface_distance_senescence.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
distance_data <- bind_rows(
  mutate(stem_distance, score = "Stemness"),
  mutate(senescence_distance, score = "Senescence")
)
s6 <- ggplot(distance_data, aes(distance_bin_um, mean_score, color = Adenoma)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_spots), alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "gam", formula = y ~ s(x, bs = "cs"), se = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~score, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = region_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Distance from luminal surface (micrometers)", y = "Mean score per 100-micrometer bin")
save_plot(s6, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_surface_distance.pdf"), 6, 8)
```

# Public single-cell validation

```{r single-cell-validation}
validation <- qread(here("data", "derived", "single_cell_validation.qs"))
s7 <- imap(validation, function(object, cohort) {
  DimPlot(object, group.by = "seurat_clusters", label = TRUE) +
    FeaturePlot(object, features = c("Senepy", "Stem_Signature", "GDF15"), ncol = 3) +
    plot_annotation(title = cohort)
}) |>
  wrap_plots(ncol = 1)
save_plot(s7, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_single_cell_validation.pdf"), 12, 10)
```

# Sample-level cluster comparisons

```{r cluster-comparisons}
cluster_summary <- combined_final@meta.data |>
  group_by(Sample_ID, combined_cluster) |>
  summarise(Senepy = median(Senepy, na.rm = TRUE), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n >= 30, combined_cluster %in% c("2", "3", "4"))
s8 <- ggplot(cluster_summary, aes(combined_cluster, Senepy, group = Sample_ID, fill = combined_cluster)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_colors) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Per-sample median SenePy score")
save_plot(s8, file.path(figure_dir, "SFigure_cluster_senescence.pdf"), 5, 4)
```
